about: Shared frame fixtures for the host adapter (control_center/device.py _frame) and the firmware parser (src/control_center.cpp parse_frame). Each case: name, note, capabilities {presentation, glyphs[, artwork][, artwork2]}, input (the frame object), expect {accept, output?} describing the HOST adapter for those capabilities, and rawParity.

rules.host: device._frame(input, capabilities) must raise ValueError when expect.accept is false, otherwise return exactly expect.output (key order irrelevant).
rules.firmwareOutput: For every accepted case, a presentation-4 parser must accept expect.output and store each text field byte-identically (the host output is always valid v4/v2).
rules.firmwareRaw: When rawParity is true, a presentation-4 parser fed input directly must match expect.accept and, when accepted, store the same text as expect.output for every text field present there. rawParity is false where the host transliterates, gates on presentation < 4, trims for the budget, or strips or replaces an invalid optional field that a parser may reject (an invalid iconKey is stripped by both, so it keeps rawParity).
rules.absentFirst: Contract decision (Stage 2 review; PRESENTATION_V4.md section 2 legacy acceptance takes precedence over the section 4 default): a ring WITHOUT first is never rejected for the window rule. Host and parser derive first = 0 when count <= 20, otherwise clamp(index-9, 0, count-20), and keep colors/unavailable only when that derived first is 0 (they were relative to the implicit first 0); otherwise they are ignored. A first that is PRESENT but outside the window rule is still invalid (section 4).
rules.contract: Every expect.output is itself a valid frame for its capabilities: window rule 0 <= first <= index < first+20 (first 0 when count <= 20), colours/mask within the window, every v4 button carries icon, section-8 slimming and the 1,100 B budget. tests/test_cc_contract_v4.py checks this against an independent reading of the contract, and ring/icon/budget cases also against hand-written expectations.
rules.iconKey: ARTWORK2.md section 6: iconKey [A-Za-z0-9_-]{0,24} is sent only with artwork2 negotiated (ARTWORK2.md section 1) and only on layout windows; an empty one is omitted (slimming); an invalid one is stripped like an invalid artKey by the host, and stripped (never a rejection) by the parser, so those raw inputs have rawParity. The 1,100 B budget is unchanged.

cases.name: v4-windows-white-drops-colours

cases.name: v4-feedback-err-max-seq

cases.name: v4-empty-list-off
cases.note: Empty list: style off with count 0; unavailable must be 0 and moreIndex -1 (both defaults, omitted).

cases.name: v4-windows-derived-first
cases.note: count 45, index 30, no first (a sender without the window rule, e.g. the v2 companion): first is derived with the host window rule, clamp(30-9, 0, 45-20) = 21, never defaulted to 0; host and parser both accept (rules.absentFirst).

cases.name: v4-windows-derived-first-drops-relative
cases.note: No first but colours/mask present: they were relative to the implicit first 0, not to the derived window at 21, so host and parser ignore them (entries then render white and available; rules.absentFirst).

cases.name: v4-windows-early-index-keeps-relative
cases.note: count 45, index 5, no first: the derived first is 0, so colours/mask relative to 0 stay valid.

cases.name: v4-windows-tail-window
cases.note: Last entry of 45, no first: first = clamp(44-9, 0, 25) = 25; the window holds entries 25..44 (rules.absentFirst).

cases.name: v4-button-without-icon
cases.note: Every v4 button carries icon; a missing icon is sent as "" (tone none), never omitted.

cases.name: v4-windows-budget-trims-detail
cases.note: Worst case (section 8): 96-byte title and app name, 20 colours, full mask. Over 1,100 B the host empties the legacy detail (never drawn by v4 renderers) so the line fits the budget.

cases.name: gate-icon-key-without-artwork2

cases.name: gate-icon-key-malformed-artwork2
